content: === Introduction ===
Babiński (feminine: Babińska; plural: Babińscy) is a Polish surname. It may be transliterated as: Babinski, Babinska, Babinsky. Notable people with the surname include:
<info> Dre Babinski (born 1985), American singer, songwriter, violinist, and guitarist
<info> Henri Babinski (1855–1931), French gastronome and food writer
<info> Joseph Babinski (1857–1932), French-Polish professor of neurology
<info> Kazimierz Bąbiński [pl] (1895–1970), 27th Volhynian Infantry Division commander
<info> Stefan Babinsky (born 1996), Austrian alpine skier
<info> Wacław Babiński (1887–1957), Polish diplomat and professor at the University of Montreal
<info> Zbigniew Babiński (1896–1940), Polish military and sports aviator
=== Places ===
<info> Babinska Reka, Kyustendil Province, Bulgaria
<info> Bolshoy Babinsky, Volgograd Oblast, Russia
